values.value: • Use the strategic value of this logo or account carefully in your internal prioritisation and external storytelling. • Understand exactly why it matters: marquee brand, university reputation, market entry, or domain proof. • Protect delivery quality because this deal can become a future sales asset. • Ask what would make them comfortable serving as a public or private success story later. • Win this deal in a way that creates long-term reference value.
19|An Asset

Buyer may say, 'Please do not treat us like a logo.' Response: 'Completely fair. My priority is solving your need well. The strategic value only changes how seriously we support the account internally.'
Use this deal as a logo, story, or sector credibility play. Shape the offer so the future reference value is protected.
Low risk. Strategic value is high.
Ask: 'If this goes well, would you be open to being a reference or case example later?'
An Asset

• Build the deal and delivery plan with future referenceability in mind. • Capture the buyer outcome, implementation success, and satisfaction path early. • Ask what would need to happen for them to become a positive reference later. • Protect experience quality because references are earned after the sale. • Use the potential reference value to justify good internal support now.
19|Be a Reference

Buyer may say, 'We do not usually give references.' Response: 'Understood. My focus then is to deliver strong outcomes first. Any future advocacy can be discussed only if you are genuinely comfortable.'
Capture what makes this a usable reference and sell with that future story in mind.
Risk: Good strategic value if executed well.
Ask: 'What outcome would make this a strong reference within your industry or academic network?'
Be a Reference

• Do not overinvest because of imagined market signalling. • Evaluate the deal on current revenue, fit, and win probability. • Still deliver professionally, but do not distort commercial judgement for brand optics. • Keep focus on solving the present customer need well. • Let the deal stand on its own business merit.
19|Insignificant
Buyer may say, 'This is just a normal purchase for us.' Response: 'That is fine. I will treat it with the right level of seriousness and keep the discussion focused on current value.'
Keep the deal commercial and efficient. Do not overinvest unless the current revenue itself justifies it.
Risk: Limited strategic upside.
Say: 'We will stay focused on making this a clean, practical win without adding unnecessary complexity.'
Insignificant
